rationale: The agent verified the user by matching the provided email to a single account before sharing account/order details. It accurately reported the gift card balance ($60) from user details and identified the payment method on the recent order (Mastercard ending 4336) from the order data. When asked about applying the gift card, the agent correctly noted that the pending order allowed a payment method change and that split payments aren’t supported, then sought explicit confirmation to switch to Visa. After receiving confirmation, it performed the change using the proper tool, and the tool output shows a new Visa payment and a refund to the prior Mastercard, which the agent accurately communicated. No unsupported claims, no actions taken without confirmation, and all changes were within policy and applied to the authenticated user’s order.
